segments.ch12.s0600: Let the jury consider their verdict.
segments.ch12.s0610: He had said it for about the twentieth time that day.
segments.ch12.s0650: The idea of having the sentence first!
segments.ch12.s0700: Alice had grown to her full size by this time.
segments.ch12.s0720: You are nothing but a pack of cards!
segments.ch12.s0730: At this the whole pack rose up into the air.
segments.ch12.s0740: They came flying down upon her.
segments.ch12.s0750: She gave a little scream, half of fright and half of anger.
segments.ch12.s0760: She tried to beat them off.
segments.ch12.s0770: And found herself lying on the bank, with her head in her sister's lap.
segments.ch12.s0780: Her sister was gently brushing some dead leaves from her face.
segments.ch12.s0800: Why, what a long sleep you have had!
segments.ch12.s0810: Oh, I have had such a curious dream!
